title: Five personal AoT CLI application implementations
constraints: Ground each application in observed session history or durable memory
Represent implementation as executable DAG JSON and human project guide
Use dry-run tracker previews by default
No mutation of user vaults, PageIndex, Linear, or br trackers during design

nodes.title: Mine session and memex history
nodes.content: Identify repeated user workflows, failure modes, and durable context from session_search and memex recall.

nodes.title: Select five nuanced applications
nodes.content: Prefer applications that combine existing user tools with AoT DAG semantics: dependencies, constraints, entailments, dry-runs, and validation loops.

nodes.title: ANZCA SAQ Syntopical Model-Answer Factory
nodes.content: A repeatable command workflow that turns a batch of SAQ IDs into examiner-fit markdown answer sets with explicit evidence provenance, route/audit metadata, validation logs, and an optional br/bv project graph.

nodes.title: PageIndex R2L Evidence Crosswalk and PDF Ingestion
nodes.content: A safe ingestion project that segments local PDFs, uploads/updates PageIndex documents with R2L, records document IDs and page anchors, and emits a vault-facing crosswalk for SAQ, LO, and MCQ grounding.

nodes.title: MAK95 MCQ Five-Gate Closure and Cluster Governance
nodes.content: A controlled MCQ workflow where every row is either repaired, grounded, deduplicated, clustered, or terminal/manual with a machine-readable reason, then merged only after validator success.

nodes.title: Memex Agentic Memory Graph Maintenance Loop
nodes.content: A scheduled or on-demand maintenance project that converts session learnings into atomic cards, repairs graph topology, keeps semantic spines healthy, and validates graph health before sync.

nodes.title: Agent Tooling Release Orchestrator
nodes.content: A release orchestration project that turns tool changes into an explicit reasoning DAG with tests, docs, Caliber sync, issue-tracker previews, safe pushes, and post-release memory capture.

nodes.title: Validate runnable DAG examples
nodes.content: Run aot dag --dryRun over every example and add tests that parse/normalize the DAGs.

nodes.title: Publish implementation guide
nodes.content: Write a comprehensive guide explaining applications, commands, deliverables, validation, and rollout sequencing.
